decision: Danh tu san pham la "cong ty" va "ca nhan", KHONG phai "cong ty moi gioi" va "ca nhan moi gioi"
impact: tiet kiem: khong phai doi ten tren toan man hinh khi mang luoi mo linh vuc moi · rui ro: giai doan nay 100% la moi gioi nen ten rong hon thuc te, nguoi doc moi co the khong biet mang luoi gom ai

decision: Nhan cat theo NGU CANH (nhan chi mang phan man hinh chua cap), khong dung tieu de hai dong cung khong dung cuon ngang
impact: tiet kiem: gian toi da tu 3.0x xuong 1.8x, khong cot nao bi cat cut o kho hep, khong doi component bang · rui ro: nhan ngan chi dung TRONG man do — cung mot cot dat o man khac phai viet lai, nen kho chuoi khong dung chung nhan giua cac man

decision: KHONG lam nguon sinh cho thuoc so nhan vien giu tieng Viet sau mot tuan trong vong nay
impact: tiet kiem: vong ① khong phai dung duong do dac · rui ro: Cong Gia tri se doc bang nguong voi mot o CHUA DO, quyet release/iterate/kill mat mot can cu so
revisit: truoc khi mo Cong Gia tri cua ca nam vong

decision: KHONG viet bai kiem don vi cho LocaleProvider; chung minh that nam o ba phep do qua trinh duyet (E1/E2/E3)
impact: tiet kiem: khong dua mot khuon kiem-ve-React moi vao kho, noi moi bai kiem hien tai deu la ham thuan · rui ro: neu ba phep do trinh duyet khong chay duoc o buoc nghiem thu thi provider khong con phep do nao che

decision: Nut doi tieng la MOT DONG trong menu tai khoan, canh dong sang/toi — KHONG phai mot nut rieng o thanh dau trang nhu ke hoach viet
impact: tiet kiem: di dung nep san co cua kho, khong them nut moi vao thanh dau, khong dung kieu dang moi · rui ro: AC-10 da duyet viet nhu the nut doi tieng la mot nut rieng (Tab toi no roi Enter thi MENU mo ra); voi cach nay, Tab toi la toi nut menu tai khoan. Chat cua tieu chi — toi duoc bang ban phim, co vong tieu diem nhin thay, menu mo — van dung, nhung cau chu thi khong khop. NGUOI phe o Cong 2.

decision: DUNG va theo luat dung-va: AC-6 va AC-9 cung TRUOT vi mot ly do — hop dong hua ve mot man hinh ma chinh no cam sua component dung chung ve ra man hinh do
impact: lan thu HAI cung mot lop loi: phan bien bat o P0, toi va bang cach goi ten HAI ngoai le, vong cham chung minh danh sach ngoai le thieu. Khung sai chu khong phai chi tiet sai — nguoi chon duong, may khong tu va tiep
revisit: nguoi chon mot trong ba duong o Cong 2

decision: Nguoi chon Duong C: dao thu tu nam vong, dua vong 2 (bo dung chung) len truoc. Vong 1 DUNG o day, khong ky Cong 2
impact: Vong 1 giu nguyen phan da lam va da xanh. Hai phep do E6 va E9 con do, va ca hai chi dong duoc sau khi vong 2 mo duong cho component dung chung nhan chuoi tu ngoai
revisit: Vong 1 chay lai S4 ngay sau khi vong 2 dong

decision: Con so trong hop dong khong duoc go bang tay nua. Mot may quet doc cay cu phap sinh ra chung, va chinh may quet do chiu mot phep do chim moi bay kieu chuoi
impact: Ban nhap dau khai 9 file / 25 chuoi. May quet dem duoc 18 file / 53 chuoi. Hai lan lien tiep toi go so do grep hep sinh ra vao mot van ban nguoi sap ky
revisit: Neu vong 3 lai can mot con so ve pham vi thi dung lai khuon nay, dung dem tay

decision: Manh Phan ky Cong 1 cho vong 2. Pham vi: 33 chuoi khoa cung, KHONG lay 20 chuoi mac dinh ma cho goi da de
impact: Sau vong 2, o ngay van doc 'No date yet' va o goi y cong ty van doc 'Search companies…'. Chung dong o vong 3

decision: Doi may quet tu 'liet ke cho duoc phep nhin' sang 'nhin moi chuoi roi tru cho chac chan khong ai doc'
impact: Huong cu bo sot hai kieu: chuoi ghep bien ket thuc bang dau, va chuoi tran trong nhanh ba ngoi. Do lai ma truoc vong: 39 chuoi khoa cung chu khong phai 33 nhu luc ky
revisit: Vong 3 dung lai huong tru, dung liet ke

decision: Nguoi chon Duong B: bo quet ma, chuyen sang cham ban ve. Dung that tung component hai lan roi so chu nguoi doc thay
impact: May quet ma va chan canary cua no da GO khoi ho so. Quet 39 khoa: bo kiem cu bat 14, bo kiem moi bat 39. Bat duoc ca chuoi tu thu vien ngoai (aria-roledescription cua dnd-kit) — thu khong may quet ma nao thay duoc
revisit: Vong 3 dung lai giàn kiem nay, khong dung lai may quet

decision: Them hai luat vao phep do: moi gia tri tieng Viet phai mang dau tieng Viet, va danh sach trung tinh sinh ra tu du lieu thu chu khong viet tay
impact: Bit hai lo vong cham 2 tim ra. Truoc: 20 khoa doi thanh tieng Anh khac ma bo kiem khong do bai nao. Sau: mot bai do ngay o khoa dau tien
revisit: Vong 3 thua ke hai luat nay

decision: Nguoi cho phep vong 2 cham mot dong o apps/app: noi be rong cot bang cong ty de dong AC-7
impact: Truoc: o 768px cot 'Thoa thuan mo' con 1,58px cho chu, hep hon chinh dau ba cham (6,85px), nen hien TRONG. Loi co san, khong phai do tieng Viet — 'Open deals' cung trong
revisit: Vong 3 nhan lai toan bo be rong cot khi dich 177 file nhan ung dung

decision: Manh Phan ky Cong 2 cho vong 2. Chin tieu chi dat co bang chung; AC-10 nhan tren bang chung vong cham 4 sau khi sua dung ba dong hoi dong neu
impact: Bo dung chung noi tieng nguoi doc. Phep do phu 43/43 khoa. Bon vong cham, ba vong sau moi lan tim ra loi do chinh vong truoc gay ra
revisit: Vong 1 chay lai S4 sau khi vong 2 dong; E6 cua no van do vi chuoi khoa cung tai cho goi trong apps/app

decision: Chay do tren may chu dev dung tu CAY LAM VIEC nay (cong 3100), khong dung may chu 3000 dang chay tu kho goc
impact: Bon luot do dau tien do nham cay. Lan nay hai cay tinh co cung mot commit nen so khong sai, nhung dot bien khong the do duoc: sua file o cay nay ma may chu doc file o cay kia. Bay dung nhu handoff canh bao
revisit: Moi vong sau: kiem `ps` xem may chu dev chay tu thu muc nao TRUOC khi tin bat ky so nao

decision: Phep do AC-6 dung lai giàn cham ban ve cua vong ②, ap len MAN HINH THAT: dung man cong ty hai lan (vi va en) roi tru phan giong het nhau. KHONG dung may quet ma
impact: Danh sach trung tinh sinh tu may chu — gia tri tu API, chu viet tat sinh bang chinh ham initialsFromName cua san pham, ngay dinh dang bang chinh Intl voi cung bo tuy chon. Khong mot dong nao viet tay

decision: Phep do dem SO LAN xuat hien, khong dem so chuoi phan biet
impact: Dem theo tap hop thi mot dot bien trung chuoi da co san tang hinh: tra headers.archived ve "Archived" trung voi nut Archived, tap hop khong doi, phep do bao XANH. Doi sang dem lan thi no do ngay
revisit: Vong ③ thua ke luat nay

decision: Sua local-date-time.tsx de bo dinh dang nhan vung nguoi doc chon, thay vi khong nhan vung nao
impact: AC-8 cua vong ① tuyen la DAT o vong cham 1, nhung cot Ngay tao in "Jul 9" cho nguoi doc tieng Viet. Chan do cu chi grep Intl.*("en-US" nen mu voi Intl.*(undefined). Day la vet mu y het loi AC-8 cua vong ② — new Intl.NumberFormat() ngoac rong. Chan do da them chieu duong C: dem moi cho dung Intl KHONG truyen vung

decision: Nam nhan cot doi: So luong ca nhan · So thoa thuan dang mo · Hoat dong gan nhat · Trang thai bo sung du lieu · Ngay luu tru
impact: Ba nhan dau tu vong nguoi la lai thu, hai nhan sau tu hoi dong cham lai. Gia phai tra: o 1024px nay co BA tieu de bi cat kem ba cham, truoc khi doi thi khong cai nao. Toi gay ra
revisit: Nguoi phe o Cong 2; neu bac thi lui ve nhan cu va nhan lai loi de doc

decision: KHONG sua theo loi cham "Hoat dong cuoi cat ra thanh tu tuc" — do lai thi chu that hien ra la "Hoat dong …", khong phai cum kia
impact: Loi cham nghe rat nang va rat de tin. Do that mat 1 luot chay. Neu tin thang thi ho so mang mot loi khong ton tai
revisit: Moi loi cham ve thu NHIN THAY duoc phai do lai truoc khi vao ho so

decision: DUNG sua nhan sau hai vong hoi dong. Hai nguoi de xuat 'So luong thoa thuan dang mo', nguoi thu ba doi huong NGUOC lai (bo han 'So'), va phep do dung ve phia nguoi thu ba
impact: Ban sua hai nguoi de xuat lam hai nhan chi khac nhau tu ky tu thu 10 thay vi thu 4 khi bi cat o 1024px. Moi huong sua deu co mot cai gia do duoc. Vá them mot luot la luot sua nhan thu ba trong cung mot vong cham

decision: Moi loi cham ve chu BI CAT phai do lai bang cach dung tung tien to roi so be rong o — khong tin mat nguoi doc anh
impact: Ba loi cham nang lien tiep deu sai: 'Hoat dong cuoi' cat ra tu tuc, 'Phu trach' cat thanh 'Phu…', 'Ngay tao' cat thanh 'N..'. Chu bi cat bang CSS khong nam trong DOM nen nguoi cham chi doan
revisit: Vong ③ thua ke luat nay

decision: lỗ-kit — ngôn ngữ mặt người: the ma REJECT in 'khong can lam gi — may dang quay lai sua code roi tu cham vong moi', nhung o vong nay eval truot vi phan viec con lai CO Y thuoc vong sau, khong phai vi code sai. Nguoi doc the se cho may lam tiep mot viec may khong lam
impact: The nuot luon hai muc quyet dinh E9 va E12 da khai UNCERTAIN, va nuot ca nam viec ngoai hop dong — dung nhung thu chi nguoi quyet duoc. Trang thai con thieu: 'truot vi pham vi, nguoi chon mo rong hay chuyen vong sau'

decision: Manh Phan chon: bon chuoi con lai chuyen sang vong ③, vong ① ky voi gioi han da khai
impact: Vong ① dong voi AC-6 CHUA dat va co ghi ro vi sao. Bon chuoi — Archived · Views · New company · o tim — cong nam nhan trang thai bo sung du lieu deu la chuoi khoa cung tai cho goi trong apps/app, nam dung trong 177 file vong ③ phai quet. Dong o day la lam hai lan
revisit: Cong 2 cua vong ③ phai do lai chinh bon chuoi nay va thay chung bien mat
